thesis: The conversation recounts how Hamish Corlett of TDM Growth Partners conducted deep, independent research on Risk Metrics Group before becoming a shareholder, including surveying clients and non-clients. Even after the company was sold in 2010, Corlett emphasized that the firm remained invested in the long run rather than seeking short-term gains.
